system.description: You lead your companions in a rhythmic chant, marking their brows with sacred ash or oil.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and they also cannot become Frightened until the next day begins.
outcomes.success: Until the next day begins, you and every ally within 60' make Panic tests with Boon.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time is lost.
outcomes.ruin: Your faith falters in front of them: you and every ally within 60' make Panic tests with Bane until the next day begins. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
